variant_note: 9P140 combat vehicle (launcher) of the 9K57 Uragan system on the ZIL-135LM 8×8 chassis – the baseline version Russia fields in numbers; not the 9K512 Uragan-1M (MZKT chassis, swappable 220/300 mm pods), not the Belarusian 9P140MB and not Ukrainian KrAZ/Tatra rebuilds

armament.main: 16 × 220 mm rocket launch tubes in three banks (6 + 6 lower, 4 upper) on a traversable mount at the rear

notes: Full 16-rocket salvo in 20 s; emplace/displace in 3 min; reload about 20 min from the 9T452 transloader (FAS: 15–20 min).
silhouette_features: long 8×8 truck (ZIL-135) with the rocket launcher box over the rear half
16 large 220 mm tubes in three banks: two lower rows of 6, an upper row of 4
in travel the launcher is traversed to point rearward over the tail, muzzles under a thin sheet-metal cover
forward cab with a blast shield that is raised over the windscreen for firing
